messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy started for `repo/inference-runtime` -> env=prod (us-west-2)
commit: d4c3b2a    tag: v3.5.0-rc2
strategy: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automated holds (10m) between steps
release window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
short notes: small batching fix, kv-cache TTL adjustment, add telemetry route_id label
runbook checklist: `smoke`, `metrics`, `tracing`, `rollback-ready`

kira: ack. watching metrics + traces. @oncall-sre you're on notice.

sam: quick Q — are we pinning model variant for this rollout or letting routing pick latest?

deploybot: config: `model_variant=redwood/guanaco-7b-q4f-v1` (pinned) — will not auto-roll other model tags during this rollout.

oncall-sre: I'll tail pods and start synthetic checks. will alert if 5xx rate > 0.5% or error-rate increases.

deploybot: canary 5% applied at 2105554380 — starting 10m hold now.

sam: seeing a slight p95 increase (~+80ms) on canary nodes, investigating. not seeing errors yet.

kira: hold traffic progression until p95 stabilizes. do not advance to 20% until green :white_check_mark:

oncall-sre: root-cause likely client-side serialization causing CPU bursts on older kernel hosts. reproducing locally, pushing a small patch to canary.

sam: hotfix image `inference-runtime:hotfix-2026-03-20-a` deployed to canary pods.

deploybot: canary 20% applied at 2105554440 — running 5m verification window.

kira: metrics look back to baseline, no error uptick. :thumbsup:

deploybot: rollout 100% applied at 2105554501 — PROD deploy finished. Final commit d4c3b2a tag v3.5.0-rc2
change window closed. rollback_required=false
short release note: batching improvement reduces small-batch cost ~12%; kv-cache TTL fix prevents stale outputs; added `route_id` telemetry label for downstream tracing.
links: CI run https://ci.redwood.ai/12345 , perf dashboard https://dash.redwood.ai/runs/9876 , logs https://logs.redwood.ai/q/abcd1234

release-coordinator: creating release entry and publishing expanded notes to the docs repo now.

oncall-sre: post-deploy smoke started: `./scripts/smoke-prod.sh` — will post summary in 15m.

kira: thanks team. i'll keep monitoring for the next 2 hours and open a regression if anything shows up.
